block_target: Map the probability frontier at which terminal-only training produces linearly decodable, causally transplantable, planner-bound, ablation-sensitive local and global workspace semantics inside a supplied two-level hierarchy.
claim_boundary: A probabilistic phase-transition-like scaling law for workspace semantics inside one supplied synthetic hierarchy, with preregistered threshold failures preserved. Not spontaneous architecture discovery or consciousness evidence.

formula.cohort_reliability_identity: If seed outcomes are conditionally independent with per-seed probability p, probability all n seeds emerge is p^n; target all-seed reliability q therefore uses p=q^(1/n).

known_limitations: The hierarchy topology, coalition membership, update order, tensor-product primitives, and bottleneck locations are supplied.
Each frozen configuration contains only four independently initialized seeds, so exact binomial uncertainty is broad.
The logistic probability surface overpredicted reliability at the two-dimensional frontier and is retained as partially falsified.
The 1200-step d2 point is post hoc and does not change the frozen 13-of-16 endpoint status.
The one-dimensional failure is empirical and topology-consistent, not a universal impossibility theorem for every discontinuous encoder.
The formula is architecture- and task-specific, not a universal cognitive scaling law.
No brain equivalence, functional awareness, subjective experience, sentience, valence, or moral-status claim follows.
next_unclosed_gap: Expose multiple possible coalition graphs and depths under communication/workspace costs, then test whether terminal objectives select when and how a hierarchy should form rather than only learning semantics inside a supplied hierarchy.
